title: peering: ed25519 challenge-response authentication
description: No IP allowlists (NAT/translation breaks them; network fabric is the right place for that). Use the existing operator ed25519 signing keypair for peer identity. Protocol (mutual — both sides authenticate): (1) each side sends 32 random bytes as a nonce; (2) each side signs (remote_nonce || local_pubkey_bytes) with its ed25519 operator key; (3) each side verifies the signature against its configured trusted_peers list. Signing over (nonce || local_pubkey) prevents relay attacks. Config: trusted_peers = ['ed25519:base64pubkey', ...] in [peering]. Adding a peer = share their operator pubkey out-of-band, add to list. Same trust model as SSH authorized_keys. Reuses the same key the peer uses to sign articles into the group log — peer transport identity and article signing identity are the same entity by design. Reject connections from peers not in trusted_peers with no protocol-level explanation (don't leak the reason).
